history: Named for the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, and named honestly.
whyItWorks: There is no balancing logic here. It is four brown spirits at full proof, and it drinks like it.
steps: Combine all four in a shot glass.
Serve at room temperature or briefly stirred with ice and strained.
techniqueNotes: Traditionally Jack Daniel’s, Jim Beam, Johnnie Walker and José Cuervo — substitute the tequila for the Irish if you want the literal version.
name: Four Horsemen
description: Four whiskeys in one glass, one from each of the famous Jacks and Jims.
